correctness.rationale: The Jacobi generator and boundary condition yield a hypergeometric first-passage Laplace transform. Factoring its coefficients and differentiating produces an exact positive-series expression for the mean-weighted coefficient-of-variation deficit. A strict covariance argument establishes its threshold monotonicity, divergent positive weights and telescoping establish the harmonic endpoint, and an independent ODE calculation establishes the high-fidelity mean asymptotics and therefore both relative-variance corrections. The 196 finite assertions check independent quadratures but are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The Fubini--Study rare-target passage problem is motivated by isotropic quantum state preparation. Existing sources provide mean passage times and broad moment formulas but not the global sharp hierarchy of fluctuations across all target fidelities. The finite additive-time correction to exponential rare-event fluctuations has a dimension-dependent exact harmonic ceiling and yields a logarithmic-versus-power-law transition. This is a structural comparison theorem, not a reparameterized numerical table or a claim of new generic Jacobi moments.
